about.title: Personal Injury Help in Monte Sereno, California
about.longDescription: Monte Sereno is a small, quiet city, but its roads still see their share of collisions. In 2024, public records show 6 injury collisions here, leaving 7 people hurt — thankfully with zero traffic deaths reported. Local corridors like Saratoga Los Gatos Road, Rt 9, La Rinconada Drive, and Winchester Boulevard carry a good portion of the town's traffic, and that's where many reported crashes tend to happen. If you or someone you love has been injured on one of these roads, or anywhere else in town, it helps to understand your options early. LawProactive is a free service — we are not a law firm, and we don't handle your case ourselves. Instead, we connect you with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened and explain what California law allows. There's no upfront cost: attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. Reaching out costs nothing and starts the process of understanding your situation.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Sooner Rather Than Later

items.title: The Clock Is Running
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the date of injury to file a personal injury claim. That window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity is involved, so early advice matters.

items.title: Shared Fault Won't Shut You Out
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for what happened. Your compensation is simply reduced by your share of fault, not eliminated.

items.title: No Ceiling on Pain-and-Suffering Claims
items.desc: Unlike some states, California places no cap on non-economic damages — like pain and suffering — in ordinary injury cases. An attorney can help you understand what that might mean for your situation.

items.title: You Pay Nothing Unless You Win
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no hourly bill and no upfront retainer. Their fee only comes out of a successful recovery.

items.question: How long do I have to file a personal injury claim in Monte Sereno?
items.answer: Under California law, most injury claims must be filed within two years of the date of injury. If your claim involves a government agency, that deadline can be as short as six months, so it's worth checking sooner rather than later.

items.question: What if I was partly at fault for my accident?
items.answer: California uses a pure comparative fault rule, so being partially responsible doesn't bar you from recovering compensation. Your total award is simply reduced by your percentage of fault.

items.question: Where do collisions tend to cluster in Monte Sereno?
items.answer: Public-record data shows reported crashes tend to happen along corridors like Saratoga Los Gatos Road, Rt 9, La Rinconada Drive, and Winchester Boulevard, with activity also peaking on Tuesdays between 5 and 7 p.m. This is simply a pattern in the reported numbers, not a judgment about any particular road.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect me with an attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service, and we are not a law firm ourselves. We simply help connect injured people with independent attorneys who work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover money.

items.question: Is there a limit on how much I can recover for pain and suffering?
items.answer: In ordinary personal injury cases, California does not cap non-economic damages such as pain and suffering. An independent attorney can help explain how this might apply to your specific circumstances.
